changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/signout-purge-per-key-try-5777.md`

- names `ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts` → `packages/auth/src/ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts` — edited by this change

  > The `try` wrapped the WHOLE loop, not each removal. A `removeItem` that threw on key `n` aborted the walk, so keys `n+1..end` were never swept, and the failure was swallowed — `AuthProvider`'s `signOut` believed the purge had completed. The entries this sweeps are the previous principal's org-scoped, PERMISSION-FILTERED app list — objectui#5198 classifies a surviving entry as a cross-principal disclosure on a shared browser, not mere staleness — so a partial sweep here is the sharper half of the same defect class objectui#5763 fixed on the sign-in path (`sweepStore` in `ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts`).

### `.changeset/tenant-header-edge-contract-5279.md`

- names `packages/auth/README.md` → `packages/auth/README.md` — edited by this change

  > `packages/auth/README.md` gains "The `X-Tenant-ID` edge contract": what the header means (a routing hint carrying the better-auth `activeOrganizationId` — not an identity claim, not an authorization input, not what scopes rows), who stamps it and under exactly which condition, who reads it, and what a reader may and may not assume. The framework half is stated as a negative with its pin — `resolveAuthzContext` takes `tenantId` from the API-key principal or `session.activeOrganizationId` and from no header — alongside `plugin-sharing`'s record that trusting `x-tenant-id` as identity *was* a vulnerability. The configuration half is quoted from the contract this package can actually resolve, `TenantRoutingConfigSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/cloud`, where `X-Tenant-ID` is the default of a configurable `tenantHeaderName` and `header` ranks second of six identification sources behind `subdomain`.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `ad694ac3d` (merge-base with origin/main): 14 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1302 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1871 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36040988866)

## Contract review

Adopted from an isolated at-tier reviewer by `domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-24T18:02Z. The reviewer wrote a model word on the `Served-tier:` line; this seat corrected it to the constant's name. Tier read off the reviewer's transcript: 70 of 70 stamped requests `claude-fable-5-1` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

### ① Derived judgments

- New `@object-ui/auth` barrel exports `getSessionOwnerChangeCount` / `subscribeSessionOwnerChange`: in memory, and a throwing listener is caught. This matches ruling B (`5818448506`).
- `SessionUserScope.adopt` `void` → `boolean`: not on the barrel. `exports` has only `.`, and no exported type references it.
- No new storage key. `DEVICE_SCOPED_KEYS` is unchanged, so the purge still sweeps both locale slots.
- The reset lands before the column, through one queue, including when the column equals A's language. A remount does not reset twice, and a late-mounting shell still resets. Both are pinned red at base and green at head.
- Late console answers for a previous owner are dropped: the `LocalizationFetchProvider` seed write and the `languageSeed` boot fetch. Pinned.
- The headline pin drives the real path (a real `I18nProvider`, a real `adopt`; only auth/adapter are mocked). The reviewer re-ran it: head 21 passed; base `9 failed / 12 passed`, `expected 'ja' not to be 'ja'`.
- 「tenant」 is fixed at the four sites the ruling lists. ⚠️ **It survives at 11 lines in `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` (109, 255, 264, 268, 278, 348, 365, 380, 383, 387, 418) and `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useUserLocale.ts:49`.** The repaired `LOCALE_SEED_STORAGE_KEY` docblock now contradicts the `resolveSeedLanguage` docblock and the 「tenant tier」 comments below it.
- `packages/auth/README.md` sits outside the claim. It is owed under the docs-driven rule; accepted.
- The hook resolves as a host with no `I18nProvider` config. The only in-repo consumer, the console, passes none, so there is no in-repo risk; the docblock states it.
- The changesets and PR body are true sentence by sentence.

### ② Semver level

- `auth` minor, and `app-shell` / `console` / `i18n` patch: correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Four new react-compiler lint warnings in `useUserLocale.ts`: warnings only, and `Lint` is green.
- Tests reach `SessionUserScope` by a cross-package relative path, because it is deliberately off the barrel.
- objectui#10051 stays out.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate` is the upstream drift, objectui#10287.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10193-language-seed-per-user`
Reviewed-by: `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Seat decision on top of the PASS: the ruling reads 「「tenant」 is corrected at **every site that says it**」, so the residual sites are owed in this PR. A prose-only patch round follows; the new head gets a prose-only re-review before ACCEPT.
